title: AI Career Roadmap Output
description: Structured output contract for the AI Career Roadmap Generator v1. The LLM's response must be parsed into exactly this shape before the backend uses it - free text is never accepted directly.

career_summary.description: Short narrative summary of the candidate's current standing relative to their stated career goal. Comes from Prompt A.

current_level.description: Candidate's current level, determined by Prompt A from years of experience and required-skills-matched count.

skill_gaps.description: The candidate's missing skills, inherited directly from skill_gap_engine.py (Week 3) - not re-derived by the LLM.

priority.description: Inherited directly from Week 3's Critical Gap / Nice-to-Have Gap categorization.

reason.description: Short explanation of why this skill matters for the target job. Comes from Prompt B, generated once per skill.

roadmap.description: Exactly 5 phases, in fixed order, from Prompt C.

skills.description: Skills assigned to this phase. Every skill here MUST also appear in skill_gaps - the LLM is not allowed to introduce skills outside that list.

goal.description: One-sentence description of what the candidate should be able to do by the end of this phase.

recommended_resources.description: Attached AFTER the roadmap is generated, by recommendation_engine.py matching against a verified resource database - never generated freely by the LLM, to prevent invented courses/URLs (Task 6).

skill.description: Which skill (from skill_gaps) this resource addresses.

resource_url.description: Must come from the verified resource database - never LLM-generated.

resume_improvements.description: Concrete, specific suggestions for improving the resume document itself (not skill gaps).
